title: FluffOS benchmark/runtime evidence manifest schema
description: Required metadata for every machine-readable benchmark, smoke, or capacity report produced from this repository. Any report that claims readiness for a release gate must carry these fields; a report missing a required field fails the evidence gate.

run_id.description: Unique run identifier, e.g. generated by the runner script.

commit_sha.description: Full git commit SHA the report was produced against.

build_config_hash.description: Hash of the CMake configure options used (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE, sanitizer/LTO/MARCH flags).

workload_version.description: Version identifier of the workload/scenario definition, so runs can be compared only within the same workload version.

command.description: Exact command line used to produce the report.

state.description: Whether queues/claims/refs returned to baseline after the run.

evidence_kind.description: Classification of the evidence. historical: produced on an earlier checkout; current: produced on the current commit; external-required: requires an environment outside this repository.

tested_sha.description: Actual SHA checked out and built for the run (equals commit_sha for local runs; merge SHA on pull_request CI).

source_sha.description: PR head SHA for pull_request runs; equals tested_sha otherwise.

raw_report.description: File name of the raw benchmark JSON this envelope wraps (same directory as the envelope).

raw_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw report bound by this envelope.
